cohort: Primiparous singleton pregnancies in women with DIE compared with controls without endometriosis
finding: While the rate of preterm birth and CD was similar between women with and without DIE, placental implantation disorders, specifically placenta praevia, were significantly more frequent in women with DIE.
mod_finding: Women with DIE/AM and placenta praevia are at risk of bleeding complications and may develop abdominal wall endometriosis after CD.
